change_interpretations.engineering_summary: Requirement text was reworded from 'unavailable/enter/log' to 'lost/switch to/record' with identical functional intent and no change to verification criteria.

assessments.reason: Verifies driver torque response under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-01. It does not exercise wheel-speed degradation or fault logging.
evidence: Requirement VCU-DR-01 is unchanged
Procedure tests pedal step response to 100 ms threshold

assessments.reason: Tests emergency brake arbitration against driver pedal demand under unchanged requirements VCU-BRK-03 and VCU-DR-01. It is unrelated to wheel-speed sensor loss.
evidence: Requirements VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03 are unchanged
Procedure inspects emergency-brake priority over pedal demand

assessments.reason: Although the requirement link is missing, the procedure tests high-load torque transient sweeps, which is unrelated to wheel-speed signal loss in VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: Requirement reference is missing
Procedure evaluates demand sweep 75–95% high-load torque transient
Workshop note confirms missing hyperlinks after migration
assessments.recommended_action: Re-link test to VCU-DR-01 during routine traceability maintenance.

assessments.reason: Measures brake actuator command latency under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03. As noted in workshop records, brake latency uses a different clock and is unrelated to sensor degradation.
evidence: Requirement VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Workshop note states brake command latency uses a different clock from torque response

assessments.reason: Exercises wheel-speed sensor disconnect and diagnostic event logging under VCU-DGN-04. The spec change is an editorial rewording with identical meaning, so procedure and pass criteria remain valid.
evidence: VCU-DGN-04 reworded with same functional meaning ('unavailable/log' to 'lost/record')
Procedure unplugs wheel-speed sensor to verify degraded mode and fault log
assessments.recommended_action: Maintain test baseline; update requirement text reference in test documentation if needed.

assessments.reason: Verifies mode change logging under unchanged requirement VCU-LOG-05. It does not exercise wheel-speed sensor loss.
evidence: Requirement VCU-LOG-05 is unchanged
Procedure logs Comfort to Sport mode changes

assessments.reason: Requirement link is TBD, test status is NOT RUN, and ownership is unclarified. Relevance to degraded mode operation cannot be settled without owner input.
evidence: Requirement link is TBD
Previous result is NOT RUN
Comment notes ownership and source link to be clarified
assessments.recommended_action: Assign owner to resolve requirement traceability and clarify test scope.

assessments.reason: Links to an unknown legacy requirement ID VCU-OLD-88. It cannot be determined from available data whether this legacy diagnostic replay relates to VCU-DGN-04.
evidence: Requirement link VCU-OLD-88 status is unknown_requirement
Comment notes imported row from updated requirements catalog
assessments.recommended_action: Map VCU-OLD-88 to current requirements catalog to establish relevance.

assessments.reason: Verifies Sport vs Comfort torque ramp profiles under unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06. It does not exercise degraded mode or diagnostic logging.
evidence: Requirement VCU-MOD-06 is unchanged
Procedure compares accelerator response under Sport vs Comfort

assessments.reason: Tests transient pedal pulse filtering under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02. It does not exercise wheel-speed signal loss.
evidence: Requirement VCU-DR-02 is unchanged
Procedure injects 7 ms false pedal pulse

assessments.reason: Evaluates torque cancellation during emergency braking under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03. It has no dependency on wheel-speed sensor degradation.
evidence: Requirement VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Procedure checks torque drop upon emergency brake request

assessments.reason: Evaluates ECU power cycle startup readiness, which is a platform behavior independent of wheel-speed sensor degradation (VCU-DGN-04).
evidence: Procedure tests ECU power cycle readiness within 500 ms
Comment indicates platform startup only
assessments.recommended_action: Assign appropriate startup requirement link during routine maintenance.
